newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active late $66 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active late $66 - USDA.

text.p: Trade turned active in the Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady to mostly $1.00 per cwt higher.

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 13,200 Slaughter steers and 8,000 heifers; 47,800 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 25,800 formulated and 800 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 65.00 to mostly 66.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 65.00 to mostly 66.00.
Wk to Date - 47,800 Week Ago - 61,000 Year Ago - 79,900
